name: NeuroTechX__moabb
behavioral_change: h5py v_old 2.10.0 to v_new 3.14.0. h5py.Dataset.__getitem__ returns bytes instead of str for variable-length string data.
downstream_effect: A membership check of a str against the bytes array read from the dataset is silently always False, so the cache deduplication silently stops working; no exception is raised and the cause must be traced back from the assertion to the encoding site.
reference_fix: The reference fix encodes str(subject) before comparing it with dset['id'][:, 0].
